Question: As-salaam-alaikum, I am girl of 22 years,my parents are seraching for bridegroom ,but they are not in success.Whoever sees my photo,they suddenly rejects.My parents r very much worried abt me due to which they fell sick with the tensions.Sometimes, i feel to commit suicide, b'coz i can't fulfill my parent's wishes for my marriage. Many times i have tried leave my home, but i have stopped, b'coz it will affect my father's dignity in the society.I have tried various vazeefa's but in vain.plz help with these & pray for my parents well-wishes. Answer ID: 8181 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2001/1577=B/1429) We pray for you earnestly, may you get a proper match and the desire of you and your parents is fulfilled. Amen! Recite the below three duas hundred times each: یا جامع، یا لطیف، یا ودود Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
